PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Moments and equilibrium? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Moments and equilibrium.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Moments and equilibrium.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Moments and equilibrium.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Moments and equilibrium.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mechanical Properties of Materials? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mechanical Properties of Materials.

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Electronics? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Electronics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Electronics.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Electronics.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Electronics.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Physics? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Physics.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Physics.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Physics.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Physics.

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pressure? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pressure.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Pressure.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pressure.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pressure.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of Waves? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of Waves.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of Waves.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of Waves.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of Waves.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of Waves and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Electronics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. D — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Moments and equilibrium.

4. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mechanical Properties of Materials.

5. A — newton (N)

6. A — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Electronics.

8. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Physics.

9. D — Glucose and oxygen

10. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pressure.

11. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of Waves.

12. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
